Join us and be part of a team that is dedicated to making a difference every day.

Job Summary:
The Makeup Artist at our  MAC retail store is responsible for providing professional makeup services to customers, enhancing their natural beauty, and offering expert advice on products. This role requires a creative and skilled individual with a passion for makeup artistry and a deep understanding of beauty products and trends. The Makeup Artist will also play a key role in driving sales by promoting and recommending products.
Key Responsibilities:

Makeup Application:

Provide personalized makeup consultations and applications for consumers.
Create makeup looks for special occasions, everyday wear, and specific customer needs.
Stay up to date with the latest beauty trends and techniques to offer cutting-edge makeup services.

Customer Service:

Deliver exceptional customer service by understanding and addressing customer needs.
Educate customers on proper makeup application techniques and skincare routines.
Handle customer inquiries and resolve any concerns professionally and courteously.

Sales and Product Promotion:

Recommend and promote store products based on customer preferences and skin types.
Achieve individual sales targets by driving product sales through makeup services.
Participate in in-store events, promotions, and product launches to attract customers.

Product Knowledge:

Maintain in-depth knowledge of the store’s cosmetic and skincare products.
Keep updated on new product launches, formulations, and brand innovations.
Educate customers and team members on the benefits and features of various products.

Merchandising:

Ensure that the makeup station is clean, organized, and fully stocked with necessary products and tools.
Assist in maintaining product displays, ensuring they are visually appealing and aligned with store standards.
Monitor inventory levels of makeup products and tools and report any shortages to the store manager.

Training and Development:

Stay current with industry trends, attending training sessions and workshops as required.
Share knowledge with other team members to help them improve their product knowledge and sales techniques.

Health and Safety:

Implement hygiene and sanitation guidelines, ensuring that all makeup tools and products are cleaned and sanitized after each use.
Follow all health and safety protocols to ensure a safe environment for customers and staff.


Qualifications:

Education:

Certification or diploma in Makeup Artistry

Experience:

Minimum of 1-2 years of experience as a makeup artist, preferably in a retail environment.
Experience with a variety of makeup techniques and familiarity with different skin types and tones.

Skills:

Excellent makeup application skills, with the ability to create a variety of looks.
Strong customer service and communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.
Knowledge of cosmetic products, ingredients, and skincare routines.
Sales-oriented mindset with the ability to recommend products and meet sales targets.
Familiar with Social Media Platforms

Personal Attributes:

Creative and artistic with a keen eye for detail.
Passionate about beauty and makeup.
Friendly, approachable, and able to build trust with consumers.
Self-motivated and able to work independently or as part of a team.


Benefits:

Competitive salary


Commission on sales


Private Health Insurance


Employee discounts on company products


Opportunities for professional growth and development


Access to training sessions and beauty workshops
